imageAlt: Xildhibaanno federaal ah oo fadhiya xaflad baarlamaan (2016)
summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay in fadhiyada la hakinayo laga bilaabo 31-ka Oktoobar. Wuxuu sheegay in nidaamka cusub uu dhaqan-galin doono codbixin elektaroonig ah iyo diiwaangelin dijitaal ah.
title: Golaha Shacabka oo laba toddobaad hakiyay fadhiyada si loo rakibo nidaamka E-Parliament
